free_coin.title: How to get the fee WYNNE?
free_coin.text:
To get free coins from the system, freeze TRX for 10 days.
 After this period expires, this funds will be frozen, and ...% of the frozen amount will appear on your account.
 The tokens you received from the Wynn system for free cannot be withdrawn.
 They can only be used to buy new tickets, pay for extra numbers, and play games.

info.title: Info
info.text: The prize fund receives 90% of the collected funds
info.text1: Wynn Games is a platform for blockchain lotteries, binary options, and economic games with a transparent and independent winning algorithm.
info.text2: The Wynn Games team, as opposed to other online analogs, has integrated the decentralized Tron blockchain into the game industry, implementing all functions in an intuitive interface with the aim of destroying borders and overcoming the rules of other online lotteries.
info.text3: It doesn't really matter what country you live in and how strict are its laws.
info.text4: It offers no opportunities for external influence on the drawing process. And most importantly, all payments within the Wynn Games platform are made only in cryptocurrency. The platform accepts for payment: Tron (TRX), Tether (TRC-20), and its own native Wynn token.

buy.title: buy
buy.title3: Want to increase your chances of winning?
buy.text1: You need to choose any 5 numbers.
buy.text2: This can be done manually or by activating the “Random” mode at the top of the ticket. Use this button to select  random cells.
buy.text3: After the end of the drawing, the winning tickets are those that have 3, 4 or 5 matches
buy.text4: Add 1, 2, 3, or 4 additional numbers per ticket (for an additional fee). You can also buy additional tickets.
buy.text5: The prize fund receives 90% of the collected funds, which are distributed as follows: 3 matches - 30%, 4 matches - 30%, 5 matches - 30%.

ticket.title: YOUR TICKETS
ticket.text1: These tickets are still awaiting a draw. As soon as the winning combination is determined, it will go to the Win or Lose section.
ticket.text2: Your tickets that have 3, 4, or 5 matches (matched numbers are highlighted). These are winning tickets.

wallet.title: wallet address
wallet.text1: To replenish the wallet, copy the address and paste it into the corresponding line in the exchanger or in the wallet of another system.
wallet.text2: The Wynn wallet can only transfer cryptocurrency based on the TRON blockchain. The tokens which you can store here are listed below.
wallet.text3: * The minimum balance on your wallet cannot be lower than 5 TRX.
